description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing translation entities within the Opencart admin interface, including listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting, and loading translation data.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class for managing translations in the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations and auxiliary functions for translation management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the translation management page, initializing data for listing translations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX call to return the list view of translations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of translations based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a translation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update a translation.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns available language file paths for a given language.

methods.name: translation
methods.description: Loads translations for a specific store, language, and route.
